goal: Focused review of the current EP12 calibration gate: does completed stochastic-oracle look 6 support continuing the already-running frozen look 7/8 chain, or indicate a diagnosed method failure requiring intervention? Distinguish unresolved oracle precision from operating-characteristic failure, assess the limits of any precision forecast, and identify what may legitimately authorize real-development replay. No revision to estimand, thresholds, eligibility, resource contract or stopping rules; no final/restricted connectivity access. Review only local generated-method artifacts; this is an external scientific critique, not Formal Society or canonical acceptance.

hints_applied.current_action: existing serial Slurm refinement running; qualification dependency pending
hints_applied.data_scope: generated calibration summaries only; no real or final connectivity

criteria: Confirm the statistical/analytic specification matches the declared research question.
Verify the design matrix / model structure is well-posed (no rank deficiency, no collinear nuisance regressors).
Check contrast definitions match the reported hypotheses and their dimensions.

criteria: Synthesize correctness + completeness + judgment into a single overall_decision.
Questionable judgment OR incomplete completeness -> explore_more.

agent_instructions: Read the run artifacts yourself - BR has not read them.
For each axis, produce the required_outputs and pick a decision from decision_space.
Use kg_derived_criteria under each axis when present; cite matching KG rule_id values in correctness.findings.
Roll up to overall_decision using the rules under the overall axis.
Submit the completed verdict via submission_tool, echoing directive_id.
When submitting the verdict, include the session binding fields returned in this directive.
